### Info

ID: `parallel_subtyping`  
Namespace: `single_cell`

### Links

[{{< fa brands github >}} View source code](https://github.com/openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_composed/tree/v0.3.0/src/single_cell/parallel_subtyping)

[![](/images/viash-hub-logo.svg){.vh-icon} Browse all versions](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline_composed)

[![](/images/viash-hub-logo.svg){.vh-icon} Get run instructions](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline_composed/v0.3.0/components/single_cell/parallel_subtyping)

:::

The input is expected to already carry a major cell-type annotation in
.obs (--obs_major_cell_type) on the modality to be subtyped (--modality).
Each major cell type is then subtyped independently, so that the annotation
is tailored to the cells within that group rather than the dataset as a
whole. The reference is likewise split by its matching major cell-type
annotation (--reference_obs_major_cell_type) so that each major cell type is
subtyped only against the reference cells of that same type. The resulting
subtype labels are combined back into a single output h5mu, preserving all
original modalities and cells.

The annotation methods and per-method options are those of the
parallel_annotation workflow and are applied identically to every major
cell type.

Available annotation methods:
- CellTypist
- ScanVI with scArches
- SingleR
- SCVI integration followed by KNN label transfer
- Harmony integration followed by KNN label transfer

:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--singler_input_obs_clusters`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
.obs column with cluster identities. If provided, SingleR annotates the
aggregated cluster profiles; otherwise it annotates per observation.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--singler_de_method`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Method to detect differentially expressed genes between pairs of labels.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"classic"`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"classic"`, `"t"`, `"wilcox"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--singler_de_n_genes`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Number of differentially expressed genes per label pair to use as markers.
Defaults to a SingleR heuristic based on the number of labels.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Min]{.arg-key} `1`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--singler_quantile`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Quantile of the correlation distribution used to score each label.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.8`

[Min]{.arg-key} `0.0`

[Max]{.arg-key} `1.0`

::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--singler_fine_tune`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Whether to fine-tune label assignment after the initial classification.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}

[Default]{.arg-key} `true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--singler_fine_tuning_threshold`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Maximum difference from the maximum correlation to use in fine-tuning.
:::

`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.05`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--singler_prune`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Whether to prune low-quality labels (replaced with NA in the pruned

:::

`boolean`

[Default]{.arg-key} `true`
:::

:::::

### Consensus vote options

A final consensus_vote step (run inside parallel_annotation on each major
cell type) combines the per-method predictions into a single consensus
label via a (probability-weighted) majority vote.

As with the per-method slots, the consensus .obs columns default to
consensus_pred_<reference_obs_target> and
consensus_score_<reference_obs_target> when not set, and the suffix is
omitted when no --reference_obs_target is set.

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}
Name
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="columnheader"}
Description
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="columnheader"}
Attributes
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--run_consensus`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Run a final consensus vote combining the per-method predictions. Only
takes effect when more than one --annotation_methods is selected.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`

[Default]{.arg-key} `true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--consensus_obs_predictions`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
.obs slot for the consensus predicted cell type. Defaults to consensus_pred_<reference_obs_target>.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--consensus_obs_score`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
.obs slot for the consensus score, defined as the fraction of total
weight assigned to the winning cell type. Defaults to
consensus_score_<reference_obs_target>.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--consensus_use_probabilities`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Scale each method's vote by its per-cell prediction probability. When
false, every method votes with equal weight regardless of confidence.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`

[Default]{.arg-key} `true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--consensus_tie_label`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Label to assign when two or more cell types receive equal votes. If not
provided, tied cells are assigned a missing value.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"Unknown"`
:::
::::
:::::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_composed \
  -r v0.3.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/single_cell/parallel_subtyping/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline_composed/v0.3.0/components/single_cell/parallel_subtyping);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_composed \
  -r v0.3.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/single_cell/parallel_subtyping/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
